title: GTA 6 Prologue Gameplay Leaks Online Following Rockstar Warning
description: Extended gameplay footage revealing the GTA 6 story prologue has leaked online just hours after Rockstar warned fans about upcoming story spoilers.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Extended Gameplay From GTA 6 Prologue Leaks Online

According to a report by gaming media outlet IGN Games, extended gameplay footage revealing the story prologue of *Grand Theft Auto 6* has been posted online. This development marks a significant escalation in the ongoing wave of leaks that has persisted over the past week.

The new footage surfaced just hours after Rockstar Games issued a warning to fans, advising them to expect and guard against story spoilers. Despite these warnings from the developers, the unverified leaks continue to circulate across various online platforms, offering a deeper look into the game's opening narrative sequences.

## Impact on the Gaming Community

As one of the most anticipated titles in gaming history, *GTA6* has consistently drawn massive attention from both legitimate fans and malicious leakers. The appearance of prologue gameplay highlights the persistent challenges developers face in protecting confidential build data and pre-release materials from being prematurely exposed to the public.

## Editor's Take

The latest leak surrounding the GTA 6 story prologue is a frustrating reminder of how difficult it is to keep major releases under wraps in the modern digital age. While curiosity in the community is at an all-time high, we advise players to exercise caution online and avoid major social media platforms if they wish to experience the game's narrative completely fresh.
